svg.aria-label: Animated blood pressure comparison for VitalDB case 236
svg.title: Streaming blood pressure fit, VitalDB case 236
svg.desc: Two charts compare invasive arterial pressure with PPG-only and PPG plus ECG timing estimates over 30 minutes after calibration. Models track direction but underestimate the rise. Values are 10-second window summaries, not beat-by-beat pressure.
svg.text: 连续血压估计：一例真实波形回放
VitalDB 病例 236 · 60 秒后向滑动平均 · 校准后 30 分钟 · 175 个有效窗口 · mmHg
